name: Elvine
source:
Fleeing from a deadly attack on their village, Elvine, her father and a dragonkin soldier named Lukas must flee to an abandoned castle in the woods. There they await the news of what happened to the rest of their village while Elvine herself might find something else hidden among the walls of the castle...

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=21419]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
为了躲避对村庄的致命袭击，埃尔文、她的父亲和一名名叫卢卡斯的龙族士兵必须逃到树林中一座废弃的城堡。他们在那里等待村庄其他人发生的事情的消息，而艾尔文本人可能会在城堡的墙壁中发现其他隐藏的东西……
